dedupe_keys.name: wind farm power short term prediction using wrf model and kalman filtering

description: Rober Mamani and Patrick Hendrick publish wind-farm forecasting inputs and results for an ECOS 2019 study. Zenodo provides four monthly Excel workbooks and a README free under CC BY 4.0. January, April, June and October tables contain dates, observed and simulated wind speeds, filtered speeds, observed and simulated wind power, and power estimates filtered directly or through wind speed. These paired series can benchmark short-term renewable forecasts used in grid-operation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this comparison. The README does not establish the farm location, observation year, sampling interval or all measurement units. Four selected months cannot represent every seasonal or extreme-weather condition. Forecast independence and uncertainty require further inspection of the study. No workbook was downloaded, Kalman filter fitted or forecast error recalculated. The site tag describes the collection scale; its location is unknown.
